The landscape of the on-chain economy will shift as AI agents begin to initiate payments autonomously.

As Justin Sun noted at DAS, the value of "agentic payments" extends beyond the mere ability of machines to transfer funds; it lies in aligning AI behavior through clear incentives—enabling instant settlement for task completion, service invocation, and revenue distribution. While scalability is currently constrained by the limitations of AI models, the payment layer must first be equipped to handle high-frequency, micro-value, automated interactions.

TRON offers established speed, scale, and payment infrastructure. With mature stablecoin circulation, rapid confirmation times, and low costs, the network is ideally suited for the continuous on-chain settlements required by AI agents, rather than just occasional large-value transfers. The utility of these payment rails will be significantly amplified as agents begin autonomously purchasing computing power, paying for data, and settling collaboration rewards.

The next wave of on-chain activity is likely to emerge from scenarios where AI agents can make payments themselves. The sooner the infrastructure is ready, the smoother the rollout of real-world applications will be.
